To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the incidence of product innovation among New York State scientific instrument firms is positively correlated with the use of external sources of technical knowledge, and that firms that combine in- house and external sources of innovation are likely to outperform their counterparts that rely on either in-house or external sources alone.
the incidence of product innovation in the scientific instruments industry is higher among firms with a combination of internal and external sources of technical support.
